interface_revisions.si_charge_type_operator: Explicitly defined SI charge-type magnetic dipole operator M_S(M1) = M_mu(M1)/c (matrix element units mu_N/c, dimension e fm) separately from Rose-Brink notation. Removed confusing RB/Suhonen collocation in line 106.
interface_revisions.krane_steffen_convention: Explicitly declared adoption of the Krane-Steffen phase convention matching the +2*delta*F_k(LL') Hamilton angular correlation interference term. Noted delta_KS = -delta_RB in emission, and preserved experimental delta without arbitrary global sign flips.
interface_revisions.toy_example_cm1_harmonization: Harmonized toy example with rate constant C_M1 = 1.7583758801e13 s^-1 multiplying (E_gamma/MeV)^3 * b_M1. Explicitly expressed B_mu(M1) as mu_N^2 * dimensionless ratio. Removed hanging text '教学算例写为'.
